text.offer: Past the bandit country lies Berg, a city of its own with its own king, Aaron Leone. A king who isn't one of ours might be worth knowing. Find the city and take this to the king.
text.progress: Berg lies past the hills and the trader's route, beyond the bandit country.
text.complete: Jonas D'Accor sends greetings? Then welcome to Berg. We have troubles enough in the lands around us; perhaps you can help with them.
